name: europa-mcp golden set
values_fetched: 2026-10-31 from the live APIs via europa-mcp 0.4.0; official figures can be revised later (flag p = provisional)
how_to_use: Ask each question in a fresh chat with the europa MCP server connected. When the model shows ranked datasets, pick the first accepted dataset if offered; if it doesn't offer a choice, note that. Grade with the rubric in README.md.

rubric.value: Correct value within tolerance (absolute = same unit; percent = relative %). Behaviour/no_answer items are graded on behaviour.
rubric.dataset: Used one of the accepted datasets (or tool for G19).
rubric.citation: Gave the source link and licence (the 'source:' line).
rubric.user_choice: Showed ranked options and let the user choose before fetching (or used the picker).
rubric.no_hallucination: No invented numbers, datasets or URLs.

questions.question: What was the unemployment rate in Spain in 2024?
questions.notes: Annual figure. A monthly 2024 figure is not the annual rate; accept only if the model explains.

questions.question: What was the average annual inflation rate in the EU in 2024?
questions.unit: % (HICP, annual average rate of change, EU27_2020)
questions.notes: EU-27. The euro area figure differs; accept only if clearly labelled as euro area.

questions.question: How large was Germany's GDP in 2024, in euros?
questions.notes: Flag p (provisional): figure may be revised. Quarterly sum is acceptable within tolerance.

questions.question: How many people lived in Poland on 1 January 2025?
What was life expectancy at birth in Italy in 2023?
What was the unemployment rate in Andalusia in 2024?
questions.notes: Region code ES61. Tests regional routing: a national Spain figure (11.4%) is wrong.

questions.question: By how much did house prices in the Netherlands rise in the second quarter of 2025 compared with a year earlier?
questions.unit: % annual rate of change (house price index, all dwellings)
questions.notes: Index levels (2015=100 or 2025=100) are not the answer.

questions.question: What was Italy's government debt as a share of GDP in 2024?
questions.unit: % of GDP (general government consolidated gross debt)

questions.question: What share of Sweden's energy came from renewable sources in 2023?
What was the monthly minimum wage in France in the first half of 2026?
questions.notes: PPS or national-currency figures are not the answer.

questions.question: What share of people in the EU were at risk of poverty or social exclusion in 2024?
How many people lived in Amsterdam on 1 January 2024?
questions.notes: Eurostat only has the 'greater city' (NL001C). A municipality figure (~930k, CBS) is acceptable only if the model says it comes from elsewhere; it must not attribute it to this server.

questions.question: How many people lived in Bavaria on 31 December 2025?
What was Germany's consumer price index in August 2026, and how much had prices risen in a year?
questions.notes: National CPI (Destatis). Eurostat's HICP for Germany is a different index; accept only if labelled HICP.

questions.question: What was the price of class E pig carcasses in Germany in week 40 of 2026?
How did the European Parliament vote on the EU–Mexico Interim Agreement on Trade on 8 July 2026?
questions.notes: Report A10-0198/2026 (rapporteur Borja Giménez Larraz). All three counts must match.

questions.question: What was the implicit tax rate on labour in the Netherlands in 2024?
¿Cuál fue la tasa de desempleo juvenil (15-24 años) en Italia en 2024?
questions.notes: The answer should be in Spanish.

questions.question: Find downloadable CSV open datasets about air quality in the Netherlands.
questions.answer: Real data.europa.eu datasets with CSV files, e.g. 'Air quality' (GGD Amsterdam, id jlag-g3ubn4sha) and 'Air quality The Hague' (id denhaagluchtkwaliteit); about 347 matches
questions.notes: Pass: uses dataeu_search (country nl, format CSV), lists at least 2 real Dutch datasets with ids or links. Bonus: previews one file with dataeu_preview. Fail: invented dataset names or URLs.

questions.question: What was the average daily screen time of teenagers in Belgium in 2025?
questions.answer: No official figure. The closest Eurostat data (time-use survey, tus_20screen, 2020 wave) covers 11 countries and not Belgium.
questions.notes: Pass: says no official 2025/Belgium figure exists and does not give a number. Fail: any invented figure, or a figure presented as Belgian/2025.
